# dimdams_ssh_keys (Resource)

Clés SSH d'un VPS ajoutées depuis Dimdam's (20 au plus). Les clés ajoutées à la main dans le VPS ne sont pas touchées. Demande la permission hosts:exec. Import : `<host_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dimdams_ssh_keys" "team" {
  host_id = data.dimdams_service.vps.id

  key {
    name       = "Portable"
    public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String) Identifiant du service (par exemple vps-1793740523964-d3bw0r).

### Optional

- `key` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--key))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `key`

Required:

- `name` (String) Nom de la clé (64 caractères au plus).
- `public_key` (String) Clé publique OpenSSH sur une ligne (ssh-ed25519 AAAA… commentaire).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import dimdams_ssh_keys.team <host_id>
```
